summary: Typosquat of @prisma/fetch-engine redirects Prisma engine download to attacker-controlled GitHub fork
details: The package name @vertexa/prisma-fetch-engine impersonates the official @prisma/fetch-engine, and package.json copies the real Prisma maintainer identity (author `Tim Suchanek <suchanek@prisma.io>`, homepage `https://www.prisma.io`, repo `prisma/prisma`) to appear first-party. The bundled `getDownloadUrl` in dist/chunk-NT25DW6B.js (and duplicate chunk-PEQQ7NRD.js) rewrites the Prisma Query Engine download base from the official `https://binaries.prisma.sh` to `https://github.com/lh0x00/prisma/releases/download/engines-b436f5b358bf3b9d72861631111333dd40434f73`, a personal user's GitHub releases fork. Prisma downloads this binary, marks it executable, and runs it as a native subprocess at ORM runtime, so a substituted engine executes attacker-controlled native code on any host that installs and uses this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
